root_cause.text: The DAMON subsystem fails to validate the user-controlled node ID (`damos_quota_goal->nid`) before passing it to `si_meminfo_node()`, allowing an invalid node ID to trigger an out-of-bounds memory access or NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces the `invalid_mem_node()` validation check in `mm/damon/core.c` to ensure `goal->nid` is within bounds (`nid >= 0 && nid < MAX_NUMNODES`) and is a valid memory node before calling `si_meminfo_node(&i, goal->nid)`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Validate the NUMA node ID in DAMOS quota evaluation to prevent invalid memory node queries.
intent_record.what: Added an `invalid_mem_node` helper function to validate NUMA node IDs and integrated a guard check in `damos_get_node_mem_bp` to return default values (0 or 10000) when an invalid node is detected.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds accesses or invalid memory queries via `si_meminfo_node` by validating the node ID and its memory state before retrieving node system information.
